a11y.fact: Renders the root as a plain `<div>` carrying only `className` and `data-name`; it sets no `role`, no `tabindex` and no ARIA attribute, so the component adds no widget semantics and nothing it renders is keyboard focusable.

Renders the title as a `

`, not a heading element, so the card's name does not appear in the document's heading outline.

Destructures a fixed prop list with no rest spread, and `CardTextProps` declares `className` as its only pass-through, so a consumer cannot put `aria-*`, `id` or `role` on the rendered element through this component's API.
`metadata={false}` omits the rating and price block from the DOM entirely rather than hiding it with CSS, so it is absent from the accessibility tree, not merely invisible.
`review={false}` omits the rating line from the DOM, and because that block is nested inside the `metadata` block, `metadata={false}` removes it whatever `review` is set to.
`price={false}` omits the price line from the DOM, nested inside the `metadata` block the same way.

Renders the rating value and the review count as two adjacent `

` elements with no `aria-label` and no text identifying them as a rating, so that meaning reaches assistive technology only through the strings a consumer passes as `rating` and `reviewCount`.

Renders the price amount and the price period as two adjacent `

` elements with no accessible name joining them, so "121 EUR" and "per night" are announced as two separate paragraphs.

use_when — the component description "card information text." (Figma, node 37:2034) is a component description, not a usage region, so it is not transposed here. Nothing in Figma states where .cardText may be used, and src/index.ts#L8-L15 names it deliberately internal, reachable only through CardContainer's `layout` prop — that is a repo decision, not design documentation, so it is not an entry either.

variant_intent.metadata, .review, .price — the doc comments at src/components/cardText/cardText.tsx#L15, #L17 and #L19 state a purpose only for the `true` side of each boolean ("Shows the rating and price block.", "Shows the rating line.", "Shows the price line."). variant_intent — there is no variant axis to cover. Figma node 37:2034 is a single component, not a component set: get_metadata returns `<symbol>` and get_design_context exposes exactly three boolean component properties, `metadata`, `price` and `review`, each defaulting to true. The three keys above are those properties, not a Status or Type matrix.

variant_intent — prop names are recorded as the code has them at this commit. docs/cardContainer-naming.md proposes renaming the Figma booleans `price`, `review` and `metadata` to `showPrice`, `showReview` and `showMetadata` so that `price` is freed for the content value; no decision is recorded for or against, so the rename is open and this file takes no side.

variant_intent — `title`, `location`, `rating`, `reviewCount`, `priceAmount` and `pricePeriod` are absent because they are not variant props and Figma defines no text property behind any of them; the layers carry fixed sample content (src/components/cardText/cardText.tsx#L9-L11, docs/cardContainer-naming.md). They are named by this repo and would have to be renamed if design adds text properties.

placement — no story in src/components/cardText/cardText.stories.tsx places cardText in a context. Every story renders it bare inside the meta decorator's 278px-wide padded box, which the file itself labels "Story chrome only" (#L20-L27). No story renders it inside cardLayout or cardContainer, which is where the component actually lives.

pairs_with — no story in src/components/cardText/cardText.stories.tsx renders another component beside cardText, and src/components/cardText/cardText.tsx imports no other component, so the file composes nothing either.

required_tokens — seven of the entries above are base-layer `--core-*` reads (cardText.css #L58, #L83, #L84, #L85, #L86, #L87 and the second read of --core-type-fontweight-body-semibold-md at #L107), against CLAUDE.md's rule that components use semantic tokens only. They are recorded as the stylesheet actually reads them, not substituted. The missing semantic tokens are reported in docs/cardContainer-design-gaps.md §2 (no semantic type token carries body-md at semibold) and §3 (the rating line carries bound variables and a contradicting raw text style).

required_tokens — --component-input-gap-xs (cardText.css#L16, #L27) is an input-scoped component token used for the vertical gaps inside a card. Reported in docs/cardContainer-design-gaps.md §7; no card-scoped or semantic spacing token was substituted for it.
